text:
maya: Quick check — onboarding URSA-2B. config.json in PR points weight_uri to gs://models/ursa2b/v1/weights.pt but tokenizer entry is missing 'eos_id' and 'padding_side'. Can someone confirm before gate?

alex: I can check bucket perms. @infra-sre? (cc @jamal for tokenizer)

jamal: I'll inspect tokenizer asset. If it's spm, eos is usually 1 but it varies. pulling tokenizer.json now.

config-lint-bot: warning — config.json: missing required field 'tokenizer.eos_id' (rule: config-schema v3). Suggested: add integer or set 'inferred':true

olivia: Pulled gs://models/ursa2b/v1/tokenizer.json — looks like SentencePiece with 'eos_id': 2 in file, BUT vocab special_ids appear offset by +1 compared to our canonical layout. sample decode mismatch.

maya: can you paste the sample decode? e.g., input ' Hello' => tokens -> decode

olivia: sample: 'Hello' encoded -> [12,345,2] decode -> 'Hello' (no leading space) — looks like piece offsets missing pad_id handling.

jamal: sounds like subtoken offset vs Redwood tokenizer wrapper. we have a fallback mapping in runtime: token_offset_map: {source: 'spm', offset: -1} but config doesn't include it.

alex: i'd prefer to avoid runtime hacks. options: update tokenizer.json to match our canonical fields (special_ids pad/eos/bos) OR set explicit mapping in config with comment.

patrick: from serving infra — missing eos_id causes runtime to assume eos_id=0 which breaks streaming termination. this will fail canary.

maya: plan: 1) jamal will add tokenizer special_ids to tokenizer.json in bucket; 2) alex will add a config-lint PR that enforces presence of special_ids and rejects ambiguous offsets; 3) i'll hold the gate until canary smoke passes. :+1:

jamal: working on PR to update tokenizer.json, will reference gs://models/ursa2b/v1/tokenizer.json and include pad_id,eos_id,bos_id. ETA ~2h.

config-lint-bot: note — created lint issue #4527 for config-schema: missing tokenizer.special_ids. Rule severity: ERROR.

alex: created infra ticket for GCS read role for deploy-bot (TICKET-983). also adding unit test in model-onboard CI: load tokenizer + roundtrip decode.

maya: if jamal's change is quick i'll re-run gate. also adding a quick smoke script snippet: 

alex: ```python
from redwood.tokenizers import load_tokenizer
tk = load_tokenizer("gs://models/ursa2b/v1/tokenizer.json")
assert tk.encode(" Hello")[-1] == tk.special_ids['eos']
```

jamal: PR opened: https://git.internal/ursa2b/tokenizer-fix — pushed tokenizer.json with special_ids. config-lint-bot please recheck.

config-lint-bot: recheck complete — config.json passes schema v3. All checks green. ✅

maya: thanks — i'll re-run canary smoke. tagging @sre for canary window.

sre-bot: scheduled canary deploy at 03:00 UTC, window 30m. notifying on-call.

olivia: quick note: tokenizer model reports max_context=256k and config.seq_length=512 — that's a potential mismatch. flagging as WARNING.

maya: good catch. alex can you add CI warning if seq_length < model.max_ctx?

alex: will add linter rule to flag ctx < model.ctx_max as WARNING. PR tomorrow.

maya: closing loop: leaving gate open until canary smoke success. thanks all.
